description: Rank/search x402 sellers with a health reading from Factline's nightly probes (does a sample endpoint still answer a valid x402 payment challenge). Covers the FULL tracked index (about 1,000 sellers from public x402 catalogues, ranked by 30-day unique payers) -- raise "limit" past the default 25 to reach further down the ranking, or narrow with "query", "tag" or "network". An empty result (count:0) means the filter matched nothing among the tracked sellers; it is NOT evidence that anything is healthy. To check one specific seller use x402_seller_lookup. Returns source, license, data_as_of, origins_tracked and warnings.

limit.description: Max sellers to return, 1-1200 (default 25). The tracked index is under 1,100 sellers today, so a high limit reaches all of them.

query.description: Free text matched against seller name/host/tags (e.g. "sanctions", "exa")

name: x402_seller_health
